title.zh: Pi Durable：为什么不用 Temporal 或 Effect？
title.en: Pi Durable: why not Temporal or Effect?

sourceText:
Welcome to our Monday Meditations! 🌞

Today @badlogicgames and @mitsuhiko are talking why we built Pi Durable, a harness build around a small task-based workflow engine so long-running, multiplayer agents can suspend and resume anywhere. Also: why not Temporal or Effect.ts.

zh.title: 从单人会话走向长期、多人的 agent
zh.text: Pi Coding Agent 的会话模型适合一个人与 agent 的短期交互。两人介绍 Pi Durable 的动机：让长期运行、多人参与、包含并行分支的 agent 能在不同运行环境中暂停和恢复。

zh.title: 把执行拆成可恢复的任务
zh.text: 核心思路是分别持久化任务意图与执行结果，把模型请求、工具调用和子 agent 纳入任务图。恢复时可以知道执行停在哪里，但工具是否可以安全重放仍需要明确声明。

zh.title: 持久化 harness 不等于持久化整个世界
zh.text: 文件系统、部署和外部服务仍有自己的状态。两人强调还需要快照、幂等操作或适当的存储设计；仅仅引入一个工作流引擎，并不能自动解决所有恢复问题。

zh.title: 把执行与状态存储放在同一设计里
zh.text: 需要一起恢复的状态必须能够原子地持久化。Pi Durable 内置任务调度，让应用也能加入任务与状态；较大的数据可以放在外部存储，在 harness 中保存引用。

zh.title: 为何不直接套用 Temporal 式抽象
zh.text: 他们希望检查点、名称和版本更显式，便于 agent 修改自身代码时理解持久化数据。讨论中对比了通过重放恢复函数调用栈与恢复自包含任务树的取舍。

zh.title: 为何没有选择 Effect
zh.text: 两人肯定 Effect 的结构化并发、错误和服务组合能力，但认为这些能力本身不等于跨进程恢复。引入其工作流方案还会带来整套生态与可移植性的取舍，因此选择保持底层自包含。

zh.title: 先验证底层数据模型，再增加抽象
zh.text: 他们邀请使用者尝试仓库中的示例，反馈数据与状态模型是否满足实际需求。更高层的状态管理封装仍在探索，团队也计划用自己的产品和实际应用检验这套基础。

en.title: Beyond short-lived, single-user sessions
en.text: Pi Coding Agent’s session model suits a person working with an agent. Pi Durable targets long-running, multiplayer agents with parallel branches that can suspend and resume across different execution environments.

en.title: Break execution into recoverable tasks
en.text: The design persists task intent and results, bringing model requests, tools and subagents into a task graph. Recovery can identify where execution stopped, while tools still need to declare whether replay is safe.

en.title: A durable harness does not make the outside world durable
en.text: Filesystems, deployments and external services retain their own state. Snapshots, idempotent operations or appropriate storage design are still necessary; adding a workflow engine cannot solve every recovery problem.

en.title: Design execution and state persistence together
en.text: State that must recover together needs atomic persistence. Built-in task scheduling lets applications participate in execution and storage; large data can live elsewhere with references stored in the harness.

en.title: Why not simply adopt a Temporal-style abstraction?
en.text: They favor explicit checkpoints, names and versions so an agent changing its own code can reason about persisted data. They contrast replaying a function call stack with restoring a tree of self-contained tasks.

en.title: Why they did not choose Effect
en.text: They value Effect’s concurrency, errors and service composition, but distinguish those features from recovery across process restarts. Adopting its workflow solution also brings ecosystem and portability tradeoffs, motivating a self-contained foundation.

en.title: Validate the data model before adding abstractions
en.text: They invite users to try the repository’s examples and assess the state model against real needs. Higher-level state abstractions remain open, and the team plans to test the foundation through its own products and applications.

segments.text: Why Durable?
segments.zh: 为什么要做 Durable？

segments.text: So Pi, the coding agent, has historically been you are a single human,
segments.zh: Pi 这个编程 agent，过去的典型用法是：你一个人，

segments.text: you sit in front of a computer or you have a remote machine and you SSH into it.
segments.zh: 坐在电脑前，或者通过 SSH 连到一台远程机器。

segments.text: And you start your Pi session, you do a thing and you stop the Pi session and then you usually don't care about the session anymore.
segments.zh: 启动 Pi 会话，做点事情，然后结束会话，通常之后就不再关心这个会话了。

segments.text: So it's more like a one-to-one relationship, the sessions are ephemeral,
segments.zh: 所以它更像是一对一的关系，会话基本上是临时的，

segments.text: more or less, and everything fits snugly into memory as well because Pi
segments.zh: 而且所有东西都能轻松放进内存，因为 Pi

segments.text: historically loads the entire session into memory just to do a bunch of things.
segments.zh: 一直以来都会把整个会话加载到内存里，再做各种操作。

segments.text: It's not entirely necessary, it's just a historical artifact stemming from the fact that it's a one-on-one ephemeral session,
segments.zh: 这并不是完全必要的，只是历史原因：它本来就是一对一的临时会话，

segments.text: usually not super long, right?
segments.zh: 通常也不会特别长，对吧？

segments.text: However, does that fit all agentic applications?
segments.zh: 但这适合所有 agent 应用吗？

segments.text: I guess the answer is no.
segments.zh: 我想答案是否定的。

segments.text: If you want to have a Slack bot that stays with you for years and years and can answer multiple
segments.zh: 如果你想要一个陪你运行很多年、能同时回答多个

segments.text: people in parallel or have threads and answer there,
segments.zh: 用户，或者在线程里回复的 Slack 机器人，

segments.text: Pi is not your best option.
segments.zh: Pi 就不是最佳选择了。

segments.text: It can be done and we have like Piedolf, our Discord bot,
segments.zh: 当然也能做，比如我们有一个 Discord 机器人 Piedolf，

segments.text: who's been asleep for a couple of months because it was not so useful.
segments.zh: 不过它已经休眠了几个月，因为没那么有用。

segments.text: But it's kind of not what Pi the coding agent was built for.
segments.zh: 但这种场景确实不是 Pi 编程 agent 最初的设计目标。

segments.text: So earlier this summer we decided we needed a different kind of substrate,
segments.zh: 所以今年夏天早些时候，我们决定需要一种不同的底层基础，

segments.text: a different kind of framework or library or whatever you want to call it,
segments.zh: 一种不同的框架、库，随便你怎么称呼，

segments.text: that allows you to model this kind of agent or agentic application as well.
segments.zh: 让你也能构建这类 agent 或 agent 应用。

segments.text: Long-running agents, multiplayer, there's multiple users or other agents can interact
segments.zh: 长期运行的 agent、多人协作、多个用户或者其他 agent

segments.text: with each other.
segments.zh: 相互交互。

segments.text: And not everything should be in RAM, in memory in total.
segments.zh: 而且不应该把所有东西都完整地放在内存里。

segments.text: And it should be able to run anywhere.
segments.zh: 它还应该能在任何地方运行。

segments.text: Like Pi is obviously mostly bound to a computer-like system.
segments.zh: Pi 显然主要依赖于类似完整计算机的系统。

segments.text: We also want to run on Vercel, on Cloudflare,
segments.zh: 我们也想让它运行在 Vercel、Cloudflare、

segments.text: on E2B, on whatever you can come up with,
segments.zh: E2B，或者你能想到的其他平台上，

segments.text: where the computing substrate is potentially different than a process in an operating system.
segments.zh: 这些平台的计算环境可能并不是操作系统里的一个进程。

segments.text: For example, Cloudflare, Durable Objects, it's an entirely different execution model than what you have in a process in Node
segments.zh: 比如 Cloudflare Durable Objects，它的执行模型就完全不同于

segments.text: on your Mac or Windows machine.
segments.zh: 你在 Mac 或 Windows 机器上运行的 Node 进程。

segments.text: So yeah, and that was how Durable was born.
segments.zh: Durable 就是这样诞生的。

segments.text: And I think it's also kind of useful to just point out what maybe some of the
segments.zh: 我觉得也有必要指出，

segments.text: classical limitations are of Pi's existing session model.
segments.zh: Pi 现有的会话模型有哪些典型限制。

segments.text: And why it works quite well for the Pi coding agent, but like why it shows some limits.
segments.zh: 为什么它很适合 Pi 编程 agent，却也会显露出局限。

segments.text: And actually I think like to a large degree, those limitations are also shared with a lot of other agents.
segments.zh: 其实我觉得，很大程度上其他很多 agent 也有这些限制。

segments.text: So for a start, it writes JSON-L files.
segments.zh: 首先，它写入的是 JSONL 文件。

segments.text: And they're definitely useful.
segments.zh: 它们当然很有用。

segments.text: There's nothing fundamentally wrong with them.
segments.zh: 本身并没有什么根本性问题。

segments.text: But they're append, right?
segments.zh: 但它们采用追加写入，对吧？

segments.text: So it's like it's not very easy to rewrite those files.
segments.zh: 所以要重写这些文件并不容易。

segments.text: And as you're putting larger and larger workloads into them, they're accumulating a lot of intermediary
segments.zh: 随着你往里面放越来越大的工作负载，它们可能会积累大量

segments.text: results potentially.
segments.zh: 中间结果，

segments.text: That, yeah, are potentially wasteful.
segments.zh: 而这些东西可能很浪费。

segments.text: But the second thing is also that if you are going to have sub-agents,
segments.zh: 第二，如果你要加入子 agent，

segments.text: you would actually have to split that across dependent sessions.
segments.zh: 实际上得把它们拆到相互依赖的不同会话里。

segments.text: So Pi's tree works really,
segments.zh: Pi 的树状结构确实

segments.text: really well, particularly if you are a single writer, single user.
segments.zh: 非常好用，尤其是在单一写入者、单一用户的情况下。

segments.text: You can navigate to different parts of the tree, rewind the session, do some stuff.
segments.zh: 你可以跳到树的不同位置，回退会话，再做些操作。

segments.text: But modeling sub-agents into a single session
segments.zh: 但如果把子 agent 都放进一个会话，

segments.text: would interleave lines,
segments.zh: 记录行就会交错，

segments.text: would require some locking that doesn't exist today.
segments.zh: 还需要一些现在并不存在的锁机制。

segments.text: So like the entire tree system as it exists is very cool,
segments.zh: 所以现有的整套树状系统很酷，

segments.text: but has some limitations, let's say.
segments.zh: 但也有一些限制。

segments.text: So a lot of the work towards durable started,
segments.zh: 因此，Durable 的很多工作，

segments.text: I think, in some way or another by figuring out how to make this stuff work with a database.
segments.zh: 某种程度上是从研究如何让这些东西配合数据库开始的。

segments.text: And really, I think there are multiple things.
segments.zh: 这里其实涉及好几件事。

segments.text: Like durable means you should be able to stop and start it again.
segments.zh: 持久化执行意味着，你应该能够停止它，再重新启动。

segments.text: So it's like it suspends and picks up work.
segments.zh: 也就是可以挂起，然后接着工作。

segments.text: And that if you were to have sub-agents in it or you were to have multiple parallel things in it,
segments.zh: 如果其中有子 agent，或者同时进行的多个任务，

segments.text: it would extend to all the branches which are active at any point in time.
segments.zh: 这种能力就应该覆盖当时所有活跃的分支。

segments.text: And then the second part is that while
segments.zh: 第二点是，虽然

segments.text: Pi is quite durable even today,
segments.zh: 现在的 Pi 已经有相当程度的持久性，

segments.text: it is very easy to build stuff with it where you
segments.zh: 但你仍然很容易用它做出一些

segments.text: cannot pick up the work.
segments.zh: 无法接着运行的东西。

segments.text: And even the core agent look that we have today, if you were to continue, it could not continue on its own.
segments.zh: 甚至现有的核心 agent 循环，也不能自己恢复执行。

segments.text: So like if you were to shut down and you bring it up, you would have to write continue or something into it to actually continue to work.
segments.zh: 如果你关掉再启动，必须输入“继续”之类的话，它才会继续工作。

segments.text: And there are a lot of features that you might want to put into Pi that require extra state to be
segments.zh: 而很多你可能想加进 Pi 的功能，都需要在过程中

segments.text: persisted along the way.
segments.zh: 持久化额外的状态。

segments.text: So the classic example would be if you interrupt a tool execute
segments.zh: 典型例子就是，打断一次工具执行，

segments.text: in order to ask the user for approval,
segments.zh: 向用户请求批准。

segments.text: which again, not really the most useful case right now because I think tool
segments.zh: 当然，现在这不算特别有用的例子，因为我觉得工具

segments.text: approvals are largely gone.
segments.zh: 审批基本已经退出舞台了。

segments.text: But you could not really suspend the agent at this point in time and say like,
segments.zh: 但你确实无法在这个时间点挂起 agent，说：

segments.text: hey, we need to figure out if we can go ahead or not and then continue from there.
segments.zh: 我们先确认能不能继续，然后再从这里恢复。

segments.text: So it's like the system is quite limited in being able to suspend at points where we didn't intend
segments.zh: 所以，如果我们之前没有专门设计过某个挂起点，

segments.text: it unsuspending before.
segments.zh: 系统就很难在那里挂起并恢复。

segments.text: Yeah, I think we should probably just go through what durable means because we throw it around.
segments.zh: 对，我们应该解释一下 durable 到底是什么意思，因为一直在说这个词。

segments.text: But not a lot of people are actually very familiar with the concept.
segments.zh: 但很多人其实不太熟悉这个概念。

segments.text: So in old Pi, not old Pi, in Pi coding agent,
segments.zh: 在旧 Pi——不该说旧 Pi，是 Pi 编程 agent——里面，

segments.text: you start a session, you let the agent do something, your machine dies.
segments.zh: 你启动一个会话，让 agent 做事，结果机器挂了。

segments.text: You spin up Pi again, the same session, and that Armin said you have to write continue.
segments.zh: 你重新启动 Pi，打开同一个会话，就像 Armin 说的，还得输入“继续”。

segments.text: If there was an extension that did something in the background, that extension needs to be written in such a way that it actually spins up the background work again.
segments.zh: 如果某个扩展在后台做事，它就必须自己实现重新启动后台工作的逻辑。

segments.text: And Pi coding agent didn't help the extension with that at all.
segments.zh: Pi 编程 agent 完全不会帮扩展处理这些。

segments.text: Like everybody had to reinvent how to do that.
segments.zh: 每个人都得重新发明一遍。

segments.text: If you had a tool that was being executed when the process crashed,
segments.zh: 如果进程崩溃时有个工具正在执行，

segments.text: that tool is just aborted and not run again.
segments.zh: 这个工具就被中止了，不会自动重新运行。

segments.text: And the agent has to figure out if it should run it again and if so how and if the tool execution was a
segments.zh: agent 得自己判断要不要重跑、怎么重跑，以及这次工具执行

segments.text: destructive thing or not and so on and so forth.
segments.zh: 是不是破坏性的操作，等等。

segments.text: And then Pi doesn't have real concurrency,
segments.zh: 而且 Pi 没有真正的并发，

segments.text: meaning you always have a single agent loop.
segments.zh: 也就是说，始终只有一个 agent 循环。

segments.text: And if the process dies, we do not recover within that agent loop.
segments.zh: 如果进程挂了，我们不会恢复到那个循环内部。

segments.text: So an agent loop is basically get the user input,
segments.zh: agent 循环基本上就是：获取用户输入，

segments.text: send it to the LLM, get the response back, check if there's tool calls,
segments.zh: 发给大模型，拿到回复，检查是否有工具调用，

segments.text: execute the tools, and then do that in a loop until the LLM says I'm done.
segments.zh: 执行工具，再继续循环，直到模型说“我完成了”。

segments.text: In Pi coding agent, that just goes away.
segments.zh: 在 Pi 编程 agent 里，这些执行中的信息就丢了。

segments.text: We do not keep track of where we are in that loop basically, right?
segments.zh: 我们基本上不会记录循环执行到了哪里，对吧？

segments.text: So with Pi durable, we introduced a bunch of things that make this automatic basically.
segments.zh: Pi Durable 引入了一些机制，让这些事情基本上自动完成。

segments.text: So it kind of forces you into a durable way of thinking.
segments.zh: 它会促使你用持久化执行的方式思考。

segments.text: So first of all, that loop I just described, that is actually decomposed into what we call tasks.
segments.zh: 首先，我刚才描述的循环，会被拆成我们称为 task 的任务。

segments.text: And the task is basically just saying I intend to do a thing.
segments.zh: 一个任务基本上就是声明：我打算做一件事。

segments.text: I store this in a storage so I can remember it later.
segments.zh: 先把这个意图存起来，以后还能记住。

segments.text: I do the thing and then I store the result of the thing I did, right?
segments.zh: 执行这件事，再把执行结果存起来。

segments.text: So this gives me kind of like a sandwich and I can resume at any point here.
segments.zh: 这就像一个三明治，我能从其中任意位置恢复。

segments.text: I can resume in between intent and execution of what we call the effect.
segments.zh: 可以在意图记录之后、执行我们所说的 effect 之前恢复，

segments.text: And in between the effect and the final result and after the result, right?
segments.zh: 也可以在 effect 执行后、最终结果记录前，或者结果记录后恢复。

segments.text: And this is very nice because now you just write the thing that says I'm about to do the thing.
segments.zh: 这样很好，因为你只需要写：我准备做这件事，

segments.text: I am doing the thing.
segments.zh: 我正在做这件事，

segments.text: I did the thing.
segments.zh: 我做完了。

segments.text: And if you resume, we know exactly where in this sandwich you were and can resume from there.
segments.zh: 恢复的时候，我们就知道你停在这个“三明治”的哪一层，并从那里继续。

segments.text: And this extends to everything.
segments.zh: 这适用于所有操作。

segments.text: This extends to the request.
segments.zh: 也包括请求，

segments.text: It's being made to the LLM provider.
segments.zh: 也就是发给大模型服务商的请求。

segments.text: This extends to tools which can now mark themselves as replay safe.
segments.zh: 工具也一样，现在工具可以把自己标记为可安全重放。

segments.text: For example, a read tool is replay safe.
segments.zh: 例如，读取工具可以安全重放。

segments.text: You can just call it again and you get whatever.
segments.zh: 你再调用一次，拿到结果就行。

segments.text: A sub-agent tool is also replay safe because that same agent runs the same
segments.zh: 子 agent 工具也可以安全重放，因为子 agent 和主 agent

segments.text: tasks as the main agent.
segments.zh: 运行的是同一套任务机制。

segments.text: So all of this durability of the execution graph applies to it as well.
segments.zh: 所以，执行图的持久化能力同样适用于它。

segments.text: So that agent can just be spun up again and be told,
segments.zh: 子 agent 可以重新启动，再告诉它——

segments.text: not even be told, it automatically does continuous from where it left off.
segments.zh: 甚至不用告诉，它会自动从上次停下的地方继续。

segments.text: And so this is probably the biggest selling point of Pi Durable.
segments.zh: 这大概是 Pi Durable 最大的卖点。

segments.text: We took some inspiration from structured concurrency.
segments.zh: 我们借鉴了一些结构化并发的思想。

segments.text: It doesn't cleanly apply to everything in an agent, which to me was a very interesting observation.
segments.zh: 不过它并不能完全套用于 agent 的所有场景，这个发现对我来说很有意思。

segments.text: So structured concurrency is basically something owns another thing that does something.
segments.zh: 结构化并发基本上就是，一个执行单元拥有另一个执行单元，后者去做一些事情。

segments.text: And this other thing is not allowed to survive past the lifetime of this.
segments.zh: 后者的生命周期不能超过前者。

segments.text: This works for like 90% of tasks inside Pi Durable.
segments.zh: Pi Durable 中大约 90% 的任务都适用。

segments.text: But there's a handful of things that need this child execution to survive
segments.zh: 但有少数情况，子执行单元需要

segments.text: the lifetime of the parent.
segments.zh: 比父执行单元活得更久。

segments.text: So it's not 100% structured concurrency, but it's very close to that.
segments.zh: 所以它不是百分之百的结构化并发，但已经非常接近。

segments.text: And it gives you an escape hatch if you don't need it.
segments.zh: 而且在你不需要这种约束时，也提供了跳出机制。

segments.text: Yeah, and that's durability.
segments.zh: 对，这就是持久化执行。

segments.text: I hope any of that makes sense.
segments.zh: 希望我讲清楚了。

segments.text: And I think there's another thing we're mentioning.
segments.zh: 还有一件事值得提一下。

segments.text: So if you go to the earendil works GitHub repository, you will find that there's a project called Absurd,
segments.zh: 如果你去看 earendil-works 的 GitHub 仓库，会发现一个叫 Absurd 的项目，

segments.text: which is a durable workflow engine sitting on top of Postgres.
segments.zh: 它是构建在 Postgres 之上的持久化工作流引擎。

segments.text: And we built that originally to support a Pi-driven agent,
segments.zh: 我们最初做它，是为了支持一个由 Pi 驱动的 agent，
